item.title: Framework to guide a Mentee.
item.description: Framework on guiding mentor which results in huge impact for both mentor and mentoree.
item.content:encoded:
We all might have gone through a saying in our life time many times, “Teaching can help anyone’s career moves forward”. Teaching will put you in a situation to learn the things in depth before teaching someone.

Before pitching into the actual story. I would like to clear a few things, few of us can think like why should I teach someone, and how spending time on teaching can improve yourself as well. We always used to consider questioning as an opportunity for growth (whoever asking it). Then what can be for the tutor? you have the answer.

Right way to approach people:

Be nice to people. Someone can jump into your desk and ask you anything. Irrespective of their experience we have to follow the below approach.

  1. Wrong approach: Just answering them a fix.
  2. Better approach: Use the opportunity to teach someone something, So they can solve their problems in the future by themselves. . Teach them how to approach something. . Teach them to identify the root cause. . Teach them to doubt. . Teach them to think. . Teach them to make mistakes and learn from them. . Teach them how to teach others.

How to Set Expectations:

  1. Have Realistic expectation, as we have passed the same path we can set the realistic expectation.
  2. Don’t try to compare your mentee with you. People need time, we can’t grow a tree in short time.
  3. You cannot expect them to absorb everything at once.
  4. Maybe we might missed to notice the way how they are progressing.

Closing thoughts:

  • Teaching is an art, so don’t worry if you don’t follow the above approach, as we are learning everyday.
  • Teaching can improve you in building confidence, solidifying your own knowledge, practicing your ability to communicate effectively.

item.title: Good Qualities of a Programer.
item.content:encoded:
As a Junior dev having 2 years of experience. I have learned and followed some of the experience which are shared by my mentor. I think it has really helped me a lot. Thought of sharing a few things here.

  1. Var i=0 to var index = 0, is the first level of improvement. I personally believe this a lot. Because I find hard to read when someone has written unintended code with a poor naming convention.
  2. If anyone choose their career as programming, then they should have a mindset like (dev as a career is lifelong learning). We have to update ourself frequently.
  3. We should take care of our code as a child. We should avoid polluting the global space.
  4. Any new implementation, please don’t hit the keyboard instantly. At least spend time for thinking of how to solve this problem. Spend time for sequence diagram, naming convention (I used to spend major time on this area).
  5. Build a habit of reading others’ code. Reading other’s code will make you think wisely. Don’t hesitate to read, moreover you are not copying.
  6. Follow people who has the same mindset like you (or) who is good at things which you are doing. Learn how to debug your code by using your IDE (or) using any of your dev tools. This will save your time.

Front-end developers should remember using an alert statement had became an obsolete technique.

These are the few important things, a programmer should follow to become a better programmer. If you guys find any other things, please let me know in the comments!
